extracted.name: Pork Rib Rub
extracted.description: Smoked paprika, salt, and garlic powder are the primary ingredients in this homemade dry rub for ribs.
instruction_lines: Mix paprika, sea salt, garlic powder, black pepper, ginger, onion powder, rosemary, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl.
